title: Diesel-Electric Submarine
body:
Diesel-Electric Submarine is a submarine powered by diesel engines on the surface and batteries underwater, the classic submarine type of the twentieth century. Diesel-electric boats are quiet, affordable, and widely used by navies and for research, and they dive by flooding tanks and surfacing by blowing them.

The diesel-electric submarine is the standard image of the submarine, from wartime boats to modern coastal patrol submarines.

title: Nuclear Submarine: USS Nautilus
body:
Nuclear Submarine: USS Nautilus was the world's first nuclear-powered submarine, launched in 1954, and the first vessel to cross the North Pole under the ice in 1958. Nuclear power let submarines stay submerged for months, limited only by food and crew endurance.

USS Nautilus is a public fact of naval history, and its polar voyage proved a new era of undersea travel.
